# ZORK285.Z5 - the OPENING screen of the reference
# interpreter, word for word. Generated by tools/zref.py;
# do not hand-edit. `make zscreens` takes it again.
#
# TWO takes of the same opening. A story is free to choose
# its opening with @random - CURSES.Z5 draws a different
# epigraph every time - and both interpreters seed from the
# clock (Standard 2.4), so no single screen can be the
# answer. tools/zharness.py requires the words COMMON to
# both takes, in order: everything the story settled on
# stays in the gate, and everything it rolled for drops out
# without anyone having to declare which was which.
# geometry cols=67 rows=41
